name: zeffect_handle_effect_template_offset_event
description: zEffect::HandleEffectTemplateOffsetEvent resolves an effect template reference, builds a world position from a referenced node or reset-scratch position, applies event offsets, spawns the runtime effect instance, and returns 2.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage exercises the reset-scratch nodeRefIndex -200 path; the positive node-reference transform branch is covered through the accepted gwNode::TransformPoint dependency and Binary Ninja review.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x458eb0 validate zero-initialized position, positive nodeRefIndex lookup through nodeRefList, -200 resetScratch position path, optional gwNode::TransformPoint, x/y/z offset addition, effectTemplateRefList lookup by refIndex, SpawnRuntimeInstanceAt call, and return value 2.
zeffect_init_smoke verifies the -200 reset-scratch path, offset addition, SpawnRuntimeInstanceAt integration, and resulting effect node position.
